fixed_limiting_law_tail_scope: Conventional analytic theorem for the single limiting Bernoulli law: mass L^(2m+1)/(sqrt(2)*pi*C(1)*(2m+1)!) times (1+O(m^-1/2)), equivalently prefactor L/(4*sqrt(2)*pi^(3/2)*C(1)); upper-tail/mass ratio 1+L^2/(4m^2)+o(m^-2); controlled inverse for min{m>=0:Pr(J>=m)<=y} using two-sided ceilings. No new script, numeric assertion, or numerical certificate. No simultaneous finite-N/m tail limit, all-orders mass/tail expansion, effective onset, complex-sector theorem, or spectral Weyl expansion.
large_positive_mark_scope: Separate conventional theorem for real lambda tending to positive infinity, with exact optical-length integral. No joint large-N/growing-lambda regime, complex-sector uniformity, Weyl expansion, first correction coefficient, or numerically certified remainder constant. Only check_length.py and its diagnostic JSON are included.
